semantics: Metadata bounds for provisional review only. Every non-reference ROI and parameter range requires human review; no new cases frozen or paired. Source IDs remain optional. Only initial crop margin and displacement budgets adjusted, without changing ROI nodes, radii, tissue stiffness, or manual safeguards.

erosion_safeguard.scope_semantics: Pre-step selected target within the positive longitudinal profile support. For a ranged tube this uses its selected arc interval and Gaussian window, including the full selected cross-section before angular weighting, tissue resistance or distance-threshold proposals. The rest of the parent ROI is excluded.
erosion_safeguard.reference_semantics: Fixed immediately before this edit step, after earlier recipe steps; reused unchanged across its iterations and retries. Different named edits have separate references.
erosion_safeguard.connectivity_semantics: Each affected pre-step full-crop target component must retain exactly one six-face-connected survivor component. Pre-existing disconnected components are checked separately; no repair or minimum caliber is implied.
